devdoc.details: Resolver/arbiter are named trusted authorities, not an objective truth proof. All outcomes and timeouts credit pull balances; claims never expire or escheat.

params.outcome: 0 = NO, 1 = YES, 2 = invalid/refund. Authority ends strictly at arbitrateBy.

transferSide(uint256,bool,address).notice: Transfers exactly one funded side and its refund rights, with no extra payment.

voidExpired(uint256).notice: No resolver at proposeBy, or no arbiter at arbitrateBy, returns original stakes.

withdrawFor(address,address).notice: Anyone can relay a withdrawal; its recipient is fixed to the credited account.

userdoc.notice: A matched binary outcome book: fixed stakes, transferable claims, bonded dispute.
